textSegments:
TR2 S 750W (DC to DC Version)
 – Thermaltake Global
80 PLUS® 230V Standard Certified APFC non-modular PSU.

The TR2 S Series is certified by 80 PLUS 230V EU, saves energy through its high efficiency of up to 80% and accommodates any mainstream build with the most demanding requirements. An embedded Hydraulic Bearing Fan delivers excellent airflow at an exceptionally low noise level. Additionally, the single +12V rail design and DC-DC design enables non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance.
TR2 S Series adopts 120mm Hydraulic Bearing Fan to guarantee cool performance and silent operation.
TR2 S Series saves energy through its high energy efficiency of up to 80% and is 80 PLUS® 230V Standard certified.
The cables used for TR2 S Series are black and low-profile, users are able to properly route the cables in optimal location to prevent airflow blockage.
High quality components enable non-stop usage with stable and reliable performance, no more capacitor explosion and leakage.
High amperage Single +12V Rail & DC to DC Design

TR2 S Series is equipped with powerful +12V rails, superior performance under all types of system loading. The use of DC to DC circuit design provides very stable operation and enhanced voltage regulation.

To protect the hardware, TR2 S series is built with industry grade protections: OCP(Over Current Protection), OVP (Over Voltage Protection), UVP(Under Voltage Protection), OPP(Over Power Protection), SCP(Short Circuit Protection), OTP(Over Temperature Protection).
